# hackerone_weaknesses (Data Source)

Lists the weakness (CWE/CAPEC) catalog available to a HackerOne program.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `program_id` (String) Numeric ID of the program.

### Read-Only

- `weaknesses` (Attributes List) All weaknesses in the program's catalog, in API order (fully paginated). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--weaknesses))

<a id="nestedatt--weaknesses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `weaknesses`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Weakness description.
- `external_id` (String) External identifier (e.g. `cwe-36`, `capec-597`).
- `id` (String) HackerOne weakness ID.
- `name` (String) Weakness name.
